claim_scope: 2016 seven nominal Chinese sites: explicit geometric scene, airless centre, conditional timing and ephemeris consistency only.

REQ-DEFINITION.claim_text: At tree angle 10 degrees with band [8,12], the geometric model supplies 366 daily sunset/dusk/moon-rise calendars at each of seven nominal sites.

REQ-VALIDATION.claim_text: Against 168 predeclared JPL topocentric positions, altitude RMSE is 0.528066345 degrees and maximum absolute residual is 1.022691391 degrees; this is ephemeris consistency, not independent field validation.

REQ-BEIJING.claim_text: At the nominal Beijing site in 2016 the defined rising-Moon/post-civil-twilight scene has 13 nonempty evening windows, listed with UTC+08 times.

REQ-CHENGDU.claim_text: At the nominal Chengdu site in 2016 the defined rising-Moon/post-civil-twilight scene has 12 nonempty evening windows, listed with UTC+08 times.

REQ-GUANGZHOU.claim_text: At the nominal Guangzhou site in 2016 the defined rising-Moon/post-civil-twilight scene has 11 nonempty evening windows, listed with UTC+08 times.

REQ-HARBIN.claim_text: At the nominal Harbin site in 2016 the defined rising-Moon/post-civil-twilight scene has 14 nonempty evening windows, listed with UTC+08 times.

REQ-KUNMING.claim_text: At the nominal Kunming site in 2016 the defined rising-Moon/post-civil-twilight scene has 11 nonempty evening windows, listed with UTC+08 times.

REQ-SHANGHAI.claim_text: At the nominal Shanghai site in 2016 the defined rising-Moon/post-civil-twilight scene has 11 nonempty evening windows, listed with UTC+08 times.

uncertainty.definition_uncertainty: See five genuinely recomputed perturbations; geometric definitions dominate numerical error.

limitations: Dates are conditional on the explicit tree-angle and post-civil-twilight definitions; these are not unique historical interpretations.
JPL ephemerides are model-derived astronomical reference data, not local field observations; the reference check shares the JPL ephemeris family.
Nominal city coordinates, zero ellipsoid height, airless lunar centre, flat unobstructed horizon, UTC approximately UT1; no weather, terrain, leaf season, or human encounter probability.
The astronomical reconstruction is not a statistical prediction accuracy or a verification of the poem historical event.
Sunset uses conventional solar centre -0.833 deg; primary dusk and lunar altitude use airless centre geometry.

failure_cases: Poorer geometry or alternative dusk/tree definitions can exclude individual dates; no clear-sky visibility guarantee.
